Food License Registration: A Complete Guide

is required for businesses involved in the manufacture, processing, storage, distribution, sale, or handling of food products in India, as applicable under food safety regulations. Issued by the , it helps businesses meet prescribed food safety and hygiene standards while building consumer confidence.
Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
FSSAI registration or licensing generally depends on the nature, scale, and turnover of the food business:
Generally applicable to small food businesses with annual turnover up to , subject to applicable criteria.
Generally applicable to food businesses operating within a state that exceed the basic registration threshold and fall within the prescribed criteria.
Generally required for businesses falling under central licensing criteria, including certain large-scale businesses, importers, exporters, and specified food operators.
Restaurants, cafés, caterers, and cloud kitchens
Dairy, meat, and other food processing units
Depending on the type and nature of the business, commonly required documents include:
Identity and address proof of the applicant
List of food products and business activities
Layout plan and machinery details, where applicable
Water testing report for relevant manufacturing businesses
Details of directors/partners and other prescribed documents
Steps to Apply for FSSAI Registration/License
Identify the registration or licence required based on your business activities and scale.
Gather the required information and supporting documents.
Apply through the official FSSAI licensing portal.
An inspection may be conducted where required.
Once the application meets the applicable requirements, the FSSAI registration or licence is issued.
